response.sql: WITH status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_statuses FROM status_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_statuses) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_across_statuses;
